notes.zh: 随机遗址：基础权重10（需要《利维坦》）；不会出现在恒星、气态巨行星、小行星、起始/首都/黑洞星系或格式塔拥有的星球上；全银河最多一处；仅非格式塔帝国可见（common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3）。
notes.en: A random site with base weight 10 (needs Leviathans); never on stars, gas giants, asteroids, starting, capital or black-hole systems, or gestalt-owned bodies; at most one per galaxy; visible to non-gestalt empires only (common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, this system's name appears here.
